changelog:
Initial release of livestream-script-generator:

- Generate complete livestream sales scripts tailored to different products.
- Design persuasive wording for introductions, product pitches, and promotions.
- Help plan livestream pacing and allocate time for each segment.
- Provide interactive segments like giveaways, Q&A, and audience engagement tips.
- Offer proven sales-boosting techniques (limited time/quantity/price).
- Prepare responses for common viewer questions.
- Includes free and paid options for script generation and advanced features.
